format: Each vector has input (UTF-8 text) or inputBase64 (raw bytes). law=parse: the input is not I-JSON and MUST be rejected before hashing. law=hash: the parsed object MUST canonicalise to `canonical` and hash to `hash`, or, with expect=reject, MUST be rejected by the hash law. sameAs names a vector with the identical canonical form.

vectors.name: key-order-code-point
vectors.note: Member names sort by Unicode code point: Z < a < U+FF61 < U+1F600. Sorting by UTF-16 code unit would put U+1F600 before U+FF61, and is wrong.
